Hands-On Learning

Workshops

Small groups, good soil, and something you take home. No experience needed — just bring yourself.

Reserve a Spot

Call us at (269) 555-0193 to reserve your place. We keep groups small — usually 8–14 people — so every workshop feels personal.

We Supply Everything

All materials — soil, pots, plants, tools — are included in the workshop price. Just show up. Coffee and tea are always available.

Take It Home

Everything you make leaves with you — potted, wrapped, and ready. We'll give you a care card so you know exactly how to keep it happy.

Upcoming workshops

July 12 Saturday
Workshop · Beginner Friendly

Summer Succulent Bowls

Time 11:00am – 1:00pm
Price $48 per person
Group Size Max 12 participants
Age 10 and up

You'll arrange a mixed bowl of drought-tolerant succulents — choosing your own combination from a selection of 6–8 varieties. We'll cover soil layering, spacing for healthy growth, drainage basics, and how to keep your bowl thriving through the summer. Great for absolute beginners and a genuinely fun two hours.

  • Ceramic or terracotta bowl (yours to keep)
  • 6–8 succulent varieties to choose from
  • Cactus mix soil, decorative top dressing, and tools
  • Take-home care card
  • Coffee, tea, and light refreshments
Call to Reserve Spots filling fast
July 26 Saturday
Workshop · All Skill Levels

Repotting Clinic

Time 10:00am – 12:00pm
Price $35 per person
Group Size Max 10 participants
Bring Your own plant, or use one of ours

We'll walk through the full repotting process: how to know when it's time, how to choose the right pot size and shape, which soil mixes work for different plants, and how to handle roots without causing stress. You'll practice on your own plant or one we provide, and leave with it freshly potted and a solid plan for next time.

  • Hands-on repotting with your own plant (or one of ours)
  • Full selection of pot sizes to choose from
  • Multiple potting mix options + amendments (perlite, worm castings)
  • Root health assessment and troubleshooting Q&A
  • Take-home aftercare card

Sep 7 Sunday
Workshop · All Skill Levels

Early Fall Wreaths

Time 12:00pm – 3:00pm
Price $65 per person
Group Size Max 14 participants
Bring Just yourself

Our most popular workshop of the year. We'll build full, lush wreaths using fresh-cut eucalyptus, cedar boughs, dried seedheads, and whatever seasonal foliage is looking beautiful that weekend. No wreath-making experience needed — we walk you through everything. You leave with a finished wreath ready to hang, plus the confidence to make one yourself.

  • 12" grapevine or wire frame
  • Fresh eucalyptus, cedar, and mixed seasonal greenery
  • Dried elements: seedheads, preserved leaves, berries (seasonal)
  • Ribbon or jute for hanging
  • Floral wire, clippers, and a step-by-step guide to keep
  • Cider, tea, and a small snack spread
Call to Reserve Early registration suggested
For Your Group

Want a private
workshop?

We offer all of these workshops as private events for birthdays, showers, team outings, and more. You pick the workshop, we pick the date and handle everything else.

Private workshops run for groups of 8–25 people and can be customized in scope and duration. We can add a welcome drink, shop a discount for guests, or pair the workshop with a plant-shopping hour. Inquire by phone and we'll put together a proposal.

See Private Events

Good to Know

Reservations required. We don't do walk-in workshop spots. Call ahead and we'll hold your place.

Payment at the door. We accept cash, card, and Venmo. No deposit required for public workshops.

Kids are welcome at succulent bowl workshops (ages 10+) and wreath workshops (ages 12+).

New workshops are announced on our newsletter first. Sign up below so you don't miss a date.
